releases.author: faccuo
releases.description:
First public release.

Talk to your Obsidian notes by voice — voice-first, hands-free. Search, read and open notes, follow links and tags, write with confirmation, and say goodbye to hang up. Sessions are saved as plain Markdown notes and become the assistant's memory.

Requires your own OpenAI API key (see README for setup, network use and privacy).
